questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who supervises in an examination hall
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Invigilator.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's see the meanings of the given words-
 
 
• Inspector - **an official employed to ensure that official regulations are obeyed, especially in public services**. (स्‍कूलों, कारख़ानों आदि में नियमों के पालन आदि की जाँच करने वाला अधिकारी; निरीक्षक, इंस्‍पेक्‍टर)
 
• Manager - **a man or woman who controls an organization or part of an organization**. (प्रबंधक, पुरुष या महिला संचालक; मैनेजर)
 
• Invigilator - a person **who supervises in an examination hall**. (एक व्यक्ति जो एक परीक्षा हॉल में पर्यवेक्षण करता है; निरीक्षक)
 
• Verifier - **someone who vouches for another or for the correctness of a statement**. (जाँचकर्ता, सत्यापक)

 ​
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

__The herd are grazing__ in the fields far away from the farmer’s hut.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The herd is grazing**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the plural form of the verb ''are'' is incorrect.
 
• The subject 'The herd' in the given sentence is a singular subject.
 
• The singular form of the verb 'is' should be used with the singular subject 'The herd'.
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb ''is'' should be used in place of the plural form 'are'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: ***The herd is grazing** in the fields far away from the farmer’s hut*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number (singular or plural). (विषय और क्रिया एक दूसरे के साथ संख्या (एकवचन या बहुवचन) में सहमत होना चाहिए)
 
• Thus, if a subject is singular, its verb must also be singular; if the subject is plural, its verb must also be plural. (इस प्रकार, यदि कोई विषय एकवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए ; यदि विषय बहुवचन है , तो उसकी क्रिया भी बहुवचन होनी चाहिए)

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• रेखांकित खंड में क्रिया 'are' का बहुवचन रूप गलत है ।
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में subject 'The herd' एक एकवचन subject है।
 
• क्रिया का एकवचन रूप 'is', एकवचन subject 'The herd' के साथ प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• इसलिए बहुवचन क्रिया 'are' के स्थान पर एकवचन क्रिया 'is' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

सही वाक्य: ***The herd is grazing** in the fields far away from the farmer’s hut.*

questions.question:
**Directions: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

At the last meeting / which took place in November, / half the members submitted / their resignations on protest.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**their resignations on protest**' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the preposition 'on' is incorrect.
 
• The preposition 'on' means **about something**.
 
• The use of the word 'protest' in the sentence indicates **an action that shows that you do not like or approve of something**.
 
• Therefore, the preposition 'in' should be used in place of the preposition 'on'.
 
• The preposition 'in' is used **for showing the activity somebody is involved in**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Sentence: *At the last meeting which took place in November, half the members submitted **their resignations in protest***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य में preposition 'on' का प्रयोग गलत है।
 
• Preposition 'on' का अर्थ है **किसी वस्‍तु के विषय में, किसी वस्‍तु पर**।
 
• वाक्य में 'protest' शब्द का प्रयोग **किसी बात की नापसंदगी या अस्‍वीकृति दिखाने वाला वक्तव्‍य या कार्य; विरोध** करने का संकेत देता है।
 
• इसलिए, preposition 'in' का प्रयोग preposition 'on' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• **ऐसी गतिविधि दिखाने के लिए जिसमें कोई शामिल है** हम preposition 'in' का उपयोग किया जाता है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 2 है।

सही वाक्य: *At the last meeting which took place in November, half the members submitted their resignations in protest*.

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. He was in the habit of stealing food from others.

B. One night, the villagers decided to teach him a lesson and kept only rotten food in their kitchen.

C. The culprit ended up eating the rotten food and fell sick.

D. Once upon a time, there lived a man in a village.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DABC.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a man in a village". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
 
• Sentence A will come after D as it is giving information about the habit of the man (stealing from others).
 
• Sentence B will come after A as it is explaining what the villagers decided to do with the man one night (they decided to keep rotten food for the man).
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it is giving information about what finally happened with the man after eating rotten food.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Once upon a time, there lived a man in a village. He was in the habit of stealing food from others. One night, the villagers decided to teach him a lesson and kept only rotten food in their kitchen. The culprit ended up eating the rotten food and fell sick*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक गांव में एक आदमी" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य **A**, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह आदमी की आदत (दूसरों से चोरी) के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य B, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह समझा रहा है कि ग्रामीणों ने एक रात उस आदमी के साथ क्या करने का फैसला किया (उन्होंने आदमी के लिए सड़ा हुआ भोजन रखने का फैसला किया)।
 
• वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह इस बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है कि आखिरकार सड़ा हुआ खाना खाने के बाद आदमी के साथ क्या हुआ।

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Kamal said, “I have done my work.”

options.text: Kamal said I have done my work.
Kamal said that he has done his work.
Kamal said that I have done my work.
Kamal said that he had done his work.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Kamal said that he had done his work**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added.
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''he'', the first-person pronoun ''my'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''his''.
 
• The present perfect tense format 'Subject + have + V3 (done) + Object' will be changed into the past perfect tense format 'Subject + had + V3 (done) + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
